title: User Interface & PWA Display Standards

responsive_pwa_boundary.unified_app: Single responsive Progressive Web App serving desktop and mobile users.
responsive_pwa_boundary.no_separate_native: MUST NOT maintain separate codebase branches or templates for desktop vs mobile.
responsive_pwa_boundary.pwa_shell: Implement standard web app manifest (manifest.json) and Service Worker (sw.js).
responsive_pwa_boundary.no_offline_indication: MUST NOT display offline mode banners or imply offline transaction support.

role_based_ui_rendering: Permission-Driven Action Visibility: Automatically hide or disable non-permitted controls/buttons.
Customer Views: Never show admin controls, stock forms, payment inputs, or equipment check forms. Render confirmed details as read-only.
Staff & Admin Views: Display operational queues (pending reservations, upcoming event schedules, low stock warnings, unverified equipment dispatches).

ui_component_display_standards.date_availability: Available and booked dates visually distinct. Overlapping confirmed time slots flagged as unavailable.
ui_component_display_standards.inventory_stock_insufficiency: Visual alert badge LOW STOCK when available < threshold. INSUFFICIENT STOCK FOR ORDER when required > available.
ui_component_display_standards.equipment_accountability_grid: Columns: Equipment Name, Released Quantity, Returned Quantity (Input), Missing Quantity (Input), Damaged Quantity (Input), Discrepancy Status.

user_interaction: Inline validation messages near input fields in plain language.
Consequential authorized actions require deliberate confirmation via modal dialogs.
Printable report views use @media print stylesheets to format clean paper outputs.
visual_styling: Exact color palette, typography fonts, and branding remain UNDEFINED_BY_SOURCE.
